name: SEATEXT FREE Translation and Conversion Rate Boost
author: Seatext.com

sections.description:
🌎 Free AI Translations for 125 Languages
Translate your site into 125+ languages automatically, with 1TB of free storage for images. SEO-friendly and 100% automated—no need for a language switcher as the AI automatically detects each user’s language.

🤖 +35% Conversion Boost with AI-Driven Text
Our AI creates, tests, and optimizes text variations to increase your conversion rate—just like Amazon’s strategy with 12,000 A/B tests per year.

🛍️ +40% Sales for WooCommerce Stores
Our AI generates high-converting product descriptions and A/B tests to find the best SKU descriptions, boosting sales by up to 40%. Enhance your store with the strongest AI model for WooCommerce.

🛡️ Smallest Cookie Consent – GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and More
Minimalist cookie consent banner ensures compliance with GDPR (DSGVO, RGPD), LGPD (Brazil), POPIA (South Africa), nFADP, CCPA (California), CNIL (France), PDPL (Saudi Arabia), and PIPEDA, reducing bounce rates and maximizing conversions.

📱 Mobile-Friendly Text for Higher Conversions
Our AI optimizes content specifically for mobile screens, ensuring readability and higher engagement. Say goodbye to lengthy desktop-oriented text that doesn’t convert on mobile.

🎯 Personalized Landing Pages for Each Visitor
Connect with your CRM or clay.com to create personalized landing pages for every visitor. SEATEXT AI rewrites your website for each person, delivering a truly personalized experience—ideal for ABM and email marketing.

All content created by SEATEXT AI is SEO-friendly.

Truly free – No limits! Unlike Weglot, WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, GTranslate, Loco Translate, MultilingualPress, Babble, ConveyThis, Transposh, WooCommerce Multilingual, and others.

WORKS WITH ALL MAJOR PAGE BUILDERS:

🎨 Elementor (Free & Pro)
🎯 Divi Builder
🛠️ WPBakery
🦫 Beaver Builder
💨 Oxygen Builder
🎪 Brizy
📈 Thrive Architect
🎭 Visual Composer
⚡ Gutenberg
🧱 Bricks Builder
⚡ ZionBuilder
🎨 LiveCanvas

The first AI to actively improve your website’s – for free!
